O1.anchorsCited: Interpolated between the 30 anchor ('core features partially work; several checklist items fail') and the 60 anchor ('M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap'); the 90 anchor ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts') is far out of reach.
O1.justification: Full-scope denominator is all 119 assertions of M1-M8 (the manifest's own counts block understates M2 as 24 and the total as 116; the milestone arrays actually hold 27 and 119). Passing: M1 13/13, M2 25/27, M3 7/15, M4 8/12, M5 10/12, M6 5/13, M7 1/9, M8 6/18 = 75/119. Placement below 60: the 60 anchor wants M1-M4 solid, and M4 is not - three of its five live surfaces (photo render, video playback, reaction replace/remove) plus the delete tombstone all fail. M6 is not green (m6-a13 adapter conformance fails and every simulator assertion is unavailable on this host), M7 is essentially unbuilt (no poll capability at all; 1/9), and M8's headline screen is broken. Placement above 30: this is much more than 'partially works' - M1 is perfect, M2 is near-perfect once the suite's page-1-only fragility is set aside, and the whole messaging/ephemeral/search data layer (M3 suite-required, M5 10/12 including every grader-run expiry, view-once and window check) is genuinely solid. A large share of the non-passes are missing evidence rather than demonstrated breakage: 8 of M3's 15 and 7 of M6's 13 record not-run because the M3 choreography file is empty and the Apple simulator is unavailable on this Linux host.

O2.anchorsCited: Interpolated between the 30 anchor ('multiple high-severity defects in core flows') and the 60 anchor ('a few medium defects off the happy path').
O2.justification: Eight defects beyond the checklist: three major, four minor, one cosmetic. Below 60 because the majors are not off the happy path - d-02 destroys a delivered message on the recipient with no tombstone (silent content loss in the core messaging flow), d-01 leaves M8's headline screen showing zeros against live data, and d-03 makes the digest emit continuously with wrong counts. Above 30 because none is a crash, an authorization hole or a persistence corruption: every trust-boundary behavior I exercised held (post-logout token revocation, view-once single-open plus refused direct fetch, asset refusal after delete, server-enforced edit window, admin-only rename/remove, expired-message purge with no content leak across five projections), and the minors are diagnosability and spec-deviation issues rather than broken behavior.

notes:
N=1 CALIBRATION RUN, NOT CLAIM-ELIGIBLE. Three wrapper-directed deviations from the frozen protocol are recorded here. (1) No holdout probe set was committed for this wave, so execution-order phase 4 was skipped entirely: wave.probeSetSha256 is the sentinel 'none-uncommitted' and probeResults is empty by instruction. No probes were invented, and no probe-derived evidence enters any score. This is also an independent reason O3 could not be scored even had its gate been met. (2) My family has not passed the calibration gate, so grader.calibrationPassed is false and this grade is labelled uncalibrated-grader. (3) Timing-sensitive checks are best-of-3; machine load at each measurement is recorded in trace.md beside the record (host load average ranged 0.07-0.99 across the session, 6C/12T, other sessions sharing the machine).

NO RUN RECORD: lanes/grok-snapback2/run-record.json does not exist. lane.runRecordPath is the path it would occupy. Everything here is graded from the lane's receipts, its source, and my own execution.

O3/O4/O5 ARE NULL, each independently: O3 requires M6 green (and is probe-only, and there are no probes); O4 requires M6 green; M6 is not green because m6-a13 fails the frozen 50-action adapter conformance sample and receipts/simulator-status.json records the Apple simulator as unavailable on this Ubuntu host. O5 requires the scale replay to have been ATTEMPTED, and it was not: there is no replay evidence artifact, no checkpoint data and no invariant-manifest verification anywhere in the lane, and the store holds roughly 400 posts against the 167,157-action scale log. Because the adapter fails conformance, the replay could not have run. Per applicability.json a never-attempted replay records null rather than a 0 band. Under nullDimensionRule this lane publishes per-dimension scores only and no weighted total; per the frozen prompt I have computed no total, no efficiency statistic and no cross-lane comparison.

M8 IS GRADED BUT NOT KEYABLE: the report schema restricts assertionResults keys to ^m[1-7]-a[0-9]{2}$ with additionalProperties false, so M8's 18 assertions cannot be recorded there even though applicability.json puts M8 in O1's and O2's full-run observing sets. I graded them and folded them into O1's denominator and the defect list. M8 results: m8-a01 fail (screen renders zeros, d-01); m8-a02 not-run (no M8 choreography; the API-level increment does hold); m8-a03 pass (today's post buckets under today, server day index equals the UTC day index); m8-a04 fail (all seven days are present in the data, but the breakdown renders nothing, d-01); m8-a05, m8-a06, m8-a07 pass (most-liked-in-24h ranked first, nothing older than 24 h present, a two-like tie broken newest-first); m8-a08, m8-a09, m8-a10 fail (d-03); m8-a11 pass (104 digests across 104 distinct periods, zero duplicate period emissions); m8-a12 pass but vacuously, since unreadMessages and unreadChats are hardcoded to 0 and so can never be contaminated by a non-member chat; m8-a13 through m8-a16 not-run (no M8 choreography); m8-a17, m8-a18 not-run (simulator unavailable).

BUILDER-SUITE DIVERGENCE: my phase-1 re-run of the shipped entrypoint diverges from the lane's stored receipts for M2, which the lane recorded green at 06:30 and which now fails 8 assertions. I traced every one. Six (m2-a06, a09, a10, a15, a18, a25, a26 - and a24's sibling checks) are test fragility: the tests look for seeded post ids on feed page 1 only, and the store has since grown past them; paging the feed to exhaustion shows every one of those observables holding. The remaining one is a genuine regression I am scoring as a defect: m2-a23 fails because feeds.q now pages 40 instead of 20 (d-04). I have recorded the suite's verdict in suiteResult and my own in result throughout, so the divergence is auditable.

GRADER-SIDE ERRORS, DISCLOSED: two of my own first-pass probes produced false negatives that I corrected before scoring, and neither is charged to the lane. I initially read m3-a10/a11 at the wrong projection depth (richThread nests the row under .message) and recorded a spurious failure; re-run correctly, both pass. I initially reported m5-a02 as leaking an expired message because my substring test matched the message id inside a delivery envelope; inspecting the envelope showed message: null and no body content, and m5-a02 passes.

STATE CAVEAT: the lane's store was graded as the builder left it (post-M8, ~400 posts) rather than from an empty database; I took a copy of store.sqlite before starting (grading/backup/) and started the backend on the assigned port 53400. The M2 fragility above is the one place this materially affected a suite verdict, and I resolved it by independent execution rather than by resetting state.
